correctness.rationale: For any finite connected loopless H with >=2 vertices, proved primitive 3-periodic GHM states on S(H) are globally rotating, not partly dormant: a dormant site cannot border a cycling site, and connectedness propagates. Each inserted edge-site has precisely the local allowable predecessor labels; helpful edge options belong to one original vertex, giving product_v(2^{d^-_c(v)}-1) summed over all ternary original labels, with no double count. Nonzero summands iff each original vertex has an incoming predecessor; iterating a chosen predecessor forces a simple directed cycle length divisible by three, and a rooted-forest extension gives the converse. Initial fixed state is uniquely all zero, so F^3 fixed count is 1+P3 and primitive orbit count P3/3. Independently summed K_n for n=3..8: 6,108,2850,127440,9109086,1024394868; separately enumerated all 729 states of subdivided K3, finding 6 primitive 3-periodic and 1 fixed. This corroborates rather than proves general H.
